name: WindowsOSNameHelper
title: WindowsOSNameHelper - Global
summary: The WindowsOSNameHelper script include provides methods to handle the formatting of Windows OS names.
overview: Use in any server-side discovery scripts where you need to format OS names.

members.name: formatWindowsOSName
members.summary: Formats the given Windows OS name.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
name String The name to format
Returns
Type Description
String The formatted name

members.name: makeOSChoiceValid
members.summary: Ensures that the OS choice is valid.
members.html:
Note:
Deprecated. Use OSChoice.reconcile()
Parameters
Name Type Description
value String The value to validate
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: osCleanupName
members.summary: Cleans up the specified Windows OS name by stripping out incorrect characters, incorrect capitalization, extra spaces, or trailing spaces.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
name String The name to clean up.
Returns
Type Description
String The cleaned up name
